Our core services

01
Supply & installation · Maintenance · Annual contracts · Relocation

Cooling & air conditioning

Services for all AC types, including split units, central systems and packaged units, for homes and commercial facilities.

Explore the full service

We support the full service life of air conditioning equipment, from selecting and installing a suitable system to maintenance and ongoing care. Our scope covers split units, central air conditioning, packaged units and other AC types, with the work tailored to the equipment, its capacity, condition and use.

A site or equipment inspection establishes the requirements before work begins. For new installations, we review the space, unit locations, pipe routes and condensate drainage. For maintenance, we assess performance and investigate faults or insufficient cooling before agreeing on the repair scope.

Supply & installation
Assess the required system and capacity, supply the equipment, install units and associated connections, and test operation.
Maintenance & cleaning
Inspect indoor and outdoor units, clean appropriate components and filters, and check drainage, connections, controls and cooling problems.
Annual maintenance contracts
Arrange preventive visits and ongoing maintenance during the contract term. Included work, spare parts and exclusions are defined in the quotation.
Removal, relocation & reinstallation
Review both locations, remove and move the AC equipment, reinstall it, check connections and test operation at the new site.

Specialist work within the project scope

  • Indoor and outdoor unit maintenance
  • Safety devices and mechanical protection checks
  • Control and valve inspection and adjustment
  • Belt wear and tension checks
Arrange an inspection or quotation
02
Design · Supply · Installation · Cleaning

Central ductwork

Complete central ductwork services, from air distribution planning to supply, installation and cleaning.

Explore the full service

We provide central air ductwork for homes and facilities, from planning air distribution and routing to supplying and installing ducts and outlets. The layout considers room locations, ceiling space and the existing or proposed AC system so that the installation suits the space it serves.

Duct cleaning addresses dust and deposits in accessible sections of the air distribution system. An inspection identifies access points, a suitable cleaning method and the agreed work area, with attention to protecting the premises and the existing system.

Air distribution design
Review site requirements, duct routes and outlet locations in relation to the proposed air conditioning system.
Supply & preparation
Identify required dimensions and components, then supply the agreed ducts, connections and insulation materials.
Installation
Fit and secure ducts, connections and air outlets, connect them to the system and check airflow.
Duct cleaning
Inspect the system, establish access points and remove dust and deposits according to its condition and the agreed scope.

Specialist work within the project scope

  • Central air duct installation
  • Duct system maintenance
  • Mechanical ventilation works
  • Camera inspection of air ducts
  • Cleaning internal duct surfaces
  • Suitable cleaning tools and materials
Arrange an inspection or quotation
03
Inspection · Deposit removal · Cleaning

Chimney & exhaust cleaning

Cleaning for chimneys and exhaust passages, removing deposits that affect cleanliness and extraction performance.

Explore the full service

We clean chimneys and passages that extract smoke and cooking fumes, focusing on grease, soot and deposits within the agreed work area. For kitchen extraction systems, the hood, filters and exhaust passages are reviewed to identify the components requiring cleaning and a suitable approach.

The service starts with an inspection, access planning and protection of the surrounding area. The extent of cleaning depends on the design, condition and accessibility of the system. After the work, we review the cleaned sections and extraction condition. Appropriate cleaning frequency depends on usage and the deposits found.

System inspection
Assess deposits, the extraction route, access points and components that can be cleaned.
Site preparation
Prepare the work area and protect nearby equipment and surfaces before cleaning.
Deposit removal
Clean grease, soot and residue from the chimney, exhaust passages and filters included in the scope.
Post-cleaning review
Check the cleaned sections and extraction condition, and identify any components requiring further attention.
Arrange an inspection or quotation

General contracting

04
First fix · Wiring · Finishing · Maintenance

Electrical works

Building electrical services, from initial installation and wiring to outlets, lighting, finishing and maintenance.

Explore the full service

We carry out electrical works for homes and facilities, covering new premises, upgrades and fault repairs. Planning starts with the intended use, power points, cable routes and panel locations so that the required work and materials can be identified for the site.

Our scope includes first fix work, wiring, finishing and maintenance, coordinated with other activities at the premises. Maintenance begins with fault investigation and identification of components requiring repair or replacement, followed by checks of the points and equipment included in the work.

First fix
Plan electrical points, conduit routes and boxes, and prepare them for the site requirements.
Wiring & connections
Run cables and wiring and organize circuit and panel connections within the agreed scope.
Finishing
Install switches, sockets, lighting and required electrical components, then check operation.
Maintenance
Investigate faults, address damaged connections or components, and replace parts where required following inspection.

Specialist work within the project scope

  • Electrical and lighting works
  • Transformers and generation stations
  • Utility networks and infrastructure
  • Communications and control works
Arrange an inspection or quotation
05
First fix · Pipework · Finishing · Maintenance

Plumbing & sanitary works

Water supply and drainage installations, sanitary fittings, finishing, leak investigation and maintenance.

Explore the full service

We provide plumbing and sanitary works for homes and facilities, from laying out supply and drainage routes to installing fixtures and completing finishing work. Pipe routes and connection points are planned around kitchens, bathrooms and the other spaces requiring water and drainage.

For existing systems, we assess leaks, faults, connections and valves to identify the work needed. Components may be repaired or replaced following inspection, and completed works are checked for operation and drainage. The scope and required materials are agreed before execution.

First fix
Set out water and drainage points and prepare routes in coordination with the site layout.
Pipework
Install supply and drainage lines, connect required points and check joints and connections.
Finishing
Install agreed basins, mixers, toilets, heaters, valves and sanitary fixtures.
Maintenance
Investigate leaks and supply or drainage problems, and repair or replace connections, valves and components as needed.

Specialist work within the project scope

  • Sewer and sanitary drainage lines
  • Stormwater drainage networks
  • Residential utility networks
  • Plumbing and home maintenance
Arrange an inspection or quotation
06
Supply · Installation · Maintenance

CCTV & security cameras

Camera system supply, installation and maintenance, from coverage planning to recording and viewing checks.

Explore the full service

We provide CCTV services for homes and facilities, starting with a site inspection and identification of the areas requiring coverage. Camera positions and suitable equipment are then selected for supply and installation, considering viewing angles, lighting, cable routes and recorder location.

Installation includes connecting cameras, setting up viewing and recording, and testing the system. We also maintain existing installations by investigating lost images, recording faults, power issues and connection problems before identifying repairs or replacements. Remote viewing can be included where agreed and supported by the equipment and available network.

Coverage planning
Review entrances, corridors and required areas to establish camera positions and viewing angles.
Equipment supply
Identify cameras, recorders, storage and accessories suited to the agreed coverage requirements.
Installation & setup
Mount cameras, run connections, connect the recorder and test image quality, viewing and recording.
Maintenance
Investigate image, recording, power and connection problems and repair or replace components following inspection.

Specialist work within the project scope

  • Surveillance camera installation
  • Camera system maintenance
  • Support for complexes, hospitals and residential buildings
